The selected candidate may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute at the discretion of the MS/ Dean/ Director. Engagement is under the Central Residency Scheme and regulated by the CCS (Temporary Service Rules). The appointment gives no right to claim permanent absorption. A candidate who joins and then leaves, resigns or is terminated before completing the tenure may do so by giving one month's prior notice, or by depositing pay and allowances in lieu for the period that falls short of one month. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. False information or wilful suppression of information can lead to removal from service. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court of Jharkhand. Notices, changes in the interview date and results will be displayed on the AIIMS Deoghar website. For queries, email [email protected] or call 6432291089 (9AM-5PM, Monday to Saturday).

content_sections.text: The notice lists 159 vacancies in 40 departments. The numbers are provisional, and vacancies may increase or decrease at the time of selection at the discretion of the Executive Director & CEO, AIIMS Deoghar. Dental Surgery, Dermatology and Venereology, and Physiology show 0 vacancies in the table. The notice also states that 5% PwD reservation applies on a horizontal basis as per Government Rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Category-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: As per EWS guidelines, an EWS vacancy that cannot be filled for want of an EWS candidate is not carried forward as backlog. Other category candidates may then be allowed provisionally to apply for these posts, and they will be considered for the post as UR candidates.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed 3 years of Senior Residency will not be considered for the post advertised. Age, educational qualification and experience are determined as on the date the candidate appears in the interview/written test examination. The application form asks for the number of attempts, and an attempt certificate must be submitted. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each department.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there in AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 159 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies in 40 departments: 59 UR, 39 OBC-NCL, 31 SC, 16 ST and 14 EWS. The notice calls the numbers provisional.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The cutoff date for receiving both the soft copy and the hard copy is 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/MDS) from a recognized University/Institute. For Transfusion Medicine & Blood Bank, it is MD or DNB in Transfusion Medicine & Blood Bank.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Deoghar SR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the day of interview. SC/ST get up to five years' relaxation and OBC up to three years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for AIIMS Deoghar SR posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 3000/- for UR and Rs. 1000/- for OBC and EWS. SC/ST/PWD (all categories) and Women (all categories) pay no fee. It is paid by Demand Draft in favour of "AIIMS Deoghar".

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Fill the Offline Application Form from the AIIMS Deoghar website and send it with self-attested documents, the Demand Draft and a photograph by Speed Post to the Registrar Office, AIIMS, Devipur (Academic Block), Deoghar- 814152. Also email a soft copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at AIIMS Deoghar?
faq.answer: Pay is Level 11 of the Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs. 67,700 per month plus NPA and usual allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Selection is through interview/written test examination. The dates will be notified on the AIIMS Deoghar website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS Deoghar Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is initially for 1 year, extendable for another 2 years (maximum 3 years). It gives no right to claim permanent absorption in the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Will allowances be paid on top of the Level 11 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the entry pay of Rs. 67,700 per month is paid plus NPA and usual allowances as admissible.
